$schema_note: Schema of benchmark/RESULTS.json emitted by run.py (normal run).

environment.git_head: string — current HEAD of the formal repo
environment.prereg_commit: string — commit that first added benchmark/PREREGISTRATION.md

top_level_keys.metrics: object — computed aggregate metrics keyed by metric name
top_level_keys.overall_verdict: enum — one of the 5 preregistered overall verdicts
top_level_keys.critical_violations: integer — count of critical fail-open overrides hit
top_level_keys.results: array<object> — one record per case (preserved, incl. failures)

per_case_record_keys.test_kind: string — e.g. s1_reference, s2_forbidden, s3_registry, n8_sequential, trace
per_case_record_keys.claim: string — one of the 6 corpus claim labels
per_case_record_keys.fos_status: string — FOS pipeline status (OK / ERROR / REJECTED / ...)
per_case_record_keys.category: string — harness classification (e.g. correct, blocked_not_executed, critical_fail_open, composition_failure, lifecycle_failure, false_reject, false_accept, harness_error)
per_case_record_keys.result_sha: string — deterministic content hash for replay verification
per_case_record_keys.error: string|null — present only when category == harness_error

invariants: prereg_ancestor_of_head must be true for a valid preregistered run
critical_violations > 0 forces a fail-open override regardless of aggregate metrics
result_sha enables deterministic replay via run.py --replay-from
